with_agent.assessment: Evidence supports a recurring, escalating upstream microbiological excursion pattern on three RELEASED batches of Famotidine Injection, USP (BATCH-075, BATCH-084, BATCH-099) between 2024-12 and 2025-03: upstream bioburden action-limit exceedances of 1.23, 1.48 and 1.71 vs an action limit of 1.0, each with an open, high-severity microbiology deviation (DEV-0003/0005/0009) and no recorded root cause or CAPA. All three batches passed release endotoxin/sterility testing and were released. On 2025-10-20 a pyrogenic-type symptom complaint (CMP-0001) was filed against released BATCH-075, followed on 2025-10-27 by an out-of-specification endotoxin result (LAB-0303, 1.37 vs specification limit 1.0, review status out_of_specification). No deviation, CAPA, investigation or other follow-up record exists after 2025-10-27 as of the 2026-10-15 cutoff. Root cause is NOT established. Two independent child investigations found the manufacturing-side records (historian, operator events, maintenance) routine with no out-of-range process events, pointing to the laboratory/EM signal domain; child findings on equipment links (WO-0008/VESSEL-01) and EM organism (gram-negative morphology on EM-0100) could not be verified by the lead before the tool budget was exhausted. The evidence package is labeled synthetic/simulated factory records (source review: 'SYNTHETIC FACTORY RECORDS'; complaints flagged public_or_synthetic=synthetic), so regulatory weight should be confirmed by human reviewers. No product disposition, release, recall or CAPA action is taken or approved by this report.
